title: Ranveer Singh Begins Filming Post-Apocalyptic Thriller Pralay in Mumbai
excerpt: The Rs 300 crore zombie survival film marks Singh's debut as a producer and pairs him with Malayalam star Kalyani Priyadarshan in a genre rarely attempted at this scale in Indian cinema.
body:
• Ranveer Singh has begun filming Pralay, a Rs 300 crore post-apocalyptic zombie thriller set in a devastated Mumbai, making it his most expensive standalone project.
  • The film marks Singh's debut as a producer under his banner Ma Kasam Films, co-produced with Applause Entertainment and Hansal Mehta's True Story Films.
  • Malayalam star Kalyani Priyadarshan, who broke out with Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra, makes her Bollywood debut as the female lead.
  • Director Jai Mehta, who co-directed the acclaimed Scam 1992, helms his first feature film with a screenplay co-written with Vishal Kapoor.

Ranveer Singh has started shooting for Pralay, a post-apocalyptic zombie thriller mounted on an estimated budget of Rs 300 crore, making it the most expensive standalone project of his career. Filming has kicked off in Mumbai, with additional schedules planned in Australia later this year.

A Dystopian Mumbai on Screen

Set in a version of Mumbai ravaged by a zombie outbreak, Pralay follows a married couple fighting to survive in a collapsing city. Director Jai Mehta plans to "reimagine Mumbai in a The Hunger Games-style set-up," according to reports in Mid-Day, with large sections of the city digitally aged to create an abandoned urban landscape.

https://x.com/aliyfaizan/status/2088932948791964133

The film will rely heavily on VFX, and cinematographer Juan Carlos Gil, known for his work on Narcos, has been brought on board to shoot the project. Reports indicate that Singh will film through Diwali 2026 before taking a paternity break for his second child, with production resuming in 2027.

"Jai and his team are actively working on the screenplay, visual detailing, and the larger zombie universe. Ranveer too has been involved in creative discussions on a day-to-day basis."

— Production source, via Pinkvilla

Cross-Industry Casting

The film pairs Singh with Kalyani Priyadarshan, daughter of veteran filmmaker Priyadarshan, who is making her Hindi cinema debut with the project. Priyadarshan rose to national prominence with the Malayalam superhero blockbuster Lokah Chapter 1: Chandra in 2025 and won the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut (South) for her first film Hello! (2017). Reports indicate that Alia Bhatt was initially considered for the role before scheduling conflicts led the makers to cast Priyadarshan instead.

Singh's Producer Debut

Pralay carries additional significance as the first production under Singh's own banner, Ma Kasam Films. The project is co-produced with Applause Entertainment and True Story Films, the company of veteran filmmaker Hansal Mehta, whose son Jai is directing. Hansal Mehta has clarified that the film is an original story and not an adaptation of José Saramago's novel Blindness.

The screenplay was written by Jai Mehta and Vishal Kapoor, who previously collaborated on the maritime thriller series Lootere. For Jai Mehta, Pralay marks his feature film directorial debut after co-directing the critically acclaimed series Scam 1992: The Harshad Mehta Story with his father.

Coming Off a Career Peak

Singh enters the project on the back of a historic commercial run. His espionage thriller Dhurandhar, directed by Aditya Dhar, grossed over Rs 1,200 crore worldwide, becoming the highest-grossing Indian film of 2025. Its sequel, Dhurandhar: The Revenge, followed in March 2026.

Production has proceeded despite a non-cooperation directive issued by the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) in May 2026 over Singh's exit from Don 3. An insider told Bombay Times that "FWICE's directive has had no impact on the film whatsoever."

What to Watch

With its Rs 300 crore budget and a genre rarely attempted at this scale in Indian cinema, Pralay represents one of Bollywood's most ambitious bets on original IP. Filming is expected to continue through 2027, with a release date yet to be announced.
